# Audio Jones

> Audio Jones is the operating brand of AJ Digital LLC (Miami, FL). It provides business systems consulting for founder-led service businesses: finding where leads, jobs, and decisions get stuck, then building the agreed fix (workflows, shared business knowledge, reporting, and supervised AI tasks). Work starts with a diagnostic; scope and price are agreed before any build.

Best fit: founder-led service businesses with regular leads or repeat work, such as home service, accessibility, and home modification companies. Audio Jones does not guarantee revenue, rankings, or other outcomes.

## Start here

- [Home](https://www.audiojones.com/): what Audio Jones does and who it is for
- [Request a Diagnostic](https://www.audiojones.com/founder-intelligence/diagnostic): six-step request reviewed by a person; not an instant report
- [Solutions](https://www.audiojones.com/solutions): workflow automation, business memory, marketing attribution, AI agent systems
- [Pricing](https://www.audiojones.com/pricing): starting prices for diagnostics, implementation, and managed support
- [About](https://www.audiojones.com/about): the people and approach behind Audio Jones
- [ROI calculator](https://www.audiojones.com/roi-calculator): estimate sales at risk from missed or slow follow-up (a model, not a promise)

## Products

- [ResponseOS overview](https://www.audiojones.com/agents/responseos): revenue recovery system that captures inquiries, qualifies them, routes them to a person, and follows up
- [ResponseOS product site](https://responseos.pro/): demo, industries, and readiness assessment for ResponseOS
